method.statistic: median of three independent process medians; raw samples retained
method.host: shared M1 Max, 10 CPU, 64 GiB; uncontrolled load recorded per sample
method.cache: fresh process and private app caches; existing Numba disk cache unless explicitly stated
method.pool: portable immutable full-catalog input; pool build separately benchmarked
method.reference_timeout: full 83k related sequence exceeded 49 seconds; retained as censored trial, excluded from completed pairs
method.memory: whole worker including setup and output validation; research child separately recorded
method.precision: exact output digests; timing and pool-build elapsed fields excluded
method.scope: local recorded snapshots through 2026-05-15, not current production history or SLO evidence
